BiblicalUsage: Satan as a verb is accusing, standing against, and the picture is sharpest in Zechariah: Satan standing at the right hand of Joshua the high priest to resist him. The psalms use it of human adversaries too — they that render evil for good are mine adversaries, because I follow the thing that is good; and for my love they are my adversaries, but I give myself unto prayer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the accuser's place is always at the right hand, trying to resist, and the psalmist's answer is always the same: prayer. Accusation is answered not by argument but by going to God. And I hold that the accuser loses his case where the accused is covered by the Lord.
